packet.prompt: Audit actual rear-source texture follow math and compiler/actor wiring. Focus concrete defects in local world->source coordinates, scale or source clock across cuts, UV clipping order, pinned boundaries, affine area interpolation proof, conservative barycentric bounds, source/version/capability guards or opacity/matrix/refinement. Do not infer pixel approval, measured yaw or runtime results. Do not propose relaxing production/art/source/voice/final gates, inventing missing source or executing code. Return compact JSON {findings:[{severity,file,reason,suggestedSourceFix}],limitations:[]}; if a rule is already explicitly enforced do not flag it merely because you did not see another consumer.

findings.reason: nativeRearFollowSvg applies the unexpanded rear region clip (native-head-follow-${index}-${slot}-region) before the expanded UV clip (native-head-follow-${index}-${slot}-${i}-uv). Because the region clip matches the unexpanded rear bounds [r.x, r.y, r.width, r.height], it clips away the 2-pixel UV seam expansion across boundary triangles and suppresses destination displacement at the unpinned outer perimeter. It contradicts the specification that destination tips must not be clipped by the source region and that region/crop masking belongs only to the unwarped source texture before matrix transformations.
findings.suggestedSourceFix: In nativeRearFollowSvg, remove the outer region clip wrapper from the deformed geometry so expanded seam UVs and destination displacements are preserved, retaining only the uv clip and bank source clip: return nativeRearFollowPieces(paint,index).map(p=>{return `<g id="${p.id}"><g clip-path="url(#${p.id}-uv)"><g clip-path="url(#native-head-bank-clip-${index})"><use href="#${imageId}"/></g></g></g>`;}).join('');

findings.reason: When evaluating nativeHeadSecondary in compilePerformance (lines 982-990), headGeometry is sampled directly in physical/world coordinates at each historical sample time, but nativeHeadBankRearState expects head follow control to be expressed in head-local coordinates. Furthermore, the head angle delta passed into nativeRearFollowState adds neck alignment cell angle rather than calculating the relative head tilt/rotation velocity, causing absolute world lean/head angles to trigger large spurious translations and tanh displacements under physical tilts or walks.
findings.suggestedSourceFix: Transform sampled head secondary displacements and angles into local head coordinate space relative to current head rotation/attachment before passing control into nativeHeadBankRearState, ensuring rest posture produces zero relative displacement and rotation.

findings.reason: When measuring linear interpolation matrix errors in compiler.ts (line 1174), nativeHeadBankRearError is called passing a.face and b.face. In nativeHeadBankRearError, cell activation is checked via (from['head-view-bank-'+i] as {opacity?:number})?.opacity===1. However, nativeHeadBankFace sets 'head-view-bank-'+i and 'head-back-view-bank-'+i, but if a transition between cells occurs across samples or if opacity is 0 on the start frame of an activation transition, rear error calculation is skipped or mismatched against b.face active cells.
findings.suggestedSourceFix: In nativeHeadBankRearError, evaluate error whenever either from or to has an active rear view bank (e.g. check (from['head-back-view-bank-'+i]?.opacity===1 || (to['head-back-view-bank-'+i] as {opacity?:number})?.opacity===1)), and ensure consistency with bank rear view keys.
